rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the robot fires, the shot power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the robot's energy at the start of the turn must be strictly greater than the shot's power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

deleted_starters.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: the one rule holds
explanation.summary: Verus proved rule S1, never fire a shot you can't afford: any shot is between 100 and 3000 and costs less than the robot's energy. The battles logged violations of rules S2 and S3 (S2 from turn 0, S3 from turn 2 in both arenas), but those rules are not part of this check, so I have no details on them. No rule was rejected.
